name: TypeScript
description: JavaScript với type safety — Standard cho production apps

lessons.title: TypeScript Fundamentals
lessons.theory: TypeScript = JavaScript + types. Phát hiện lỗi tại compile-time thay vì runtime. Type annotations, interfaces, type aliases là nền tảng.
keyPoints: Interface cho object shapes, type cho unions/aliases
lessons.exercise: Define interfaces cho e-commerce: Product, Cart, Order.

lessons.title: Generics & Utility Types
lessons.theory: Generics (<T>) cho reusable typed code. Utility types: Partial, Required, Pick, Omit, Record transform types. Discriminated unions cho type-safe state.
keyPoints: Utility types: Partial, Pick, Omit transform existing types
Discriminated unions cho type-safe state management
lessons.exercise: Tạo generic useForm<T> hook với typed fields và validation.

lessons.title: Advanced Type Patterns
lessons.theory: Conditional types, mapped types, template literals cho meta-programming. infer extract types. Branded types cho domain safety. satisfies operator (TS 5+).
keyPoints: keyof T: union of all keys, T[K]: value type of key K
Branded types prevent accidental mixing of similar types
satisfies validates AND preserves narrower types
lessons.exercise: Viết type-safe event emitter với typed event names và payloads.

lessons.title: Type-Level Programming
lessons.theory: TypeScript type system là Turing-complete. Recursive types, variadic tuples, const assertions. Type-level computation cho validation, routing, ORM query builders.
keyPoints: infer keyword extract types trong conditional types
Recursive types cho deeply nested transformations
Template literal + infer = compile-time string parsing
lessons.exercise: Viết type-safe SQL query builder infer return type từ SELECT.

lessons.title: TS Compiler Internals
lessons.theory: TypeScript Compiler API cho code generation, custom linters, codemods. AST manipulation, type checker API. Performance: project references, incremental builds. Declaration merging cho library augmentation.
keyPoints: ts-morph: high-level API cho TypeScript AST manipulation
Project references: scale TS to monorepos with incremental builds
lessons.exercise: Viết custom lint rule kiểm tra naming conventions dùng TSC API.
